_format: Every piece of art this character needs besides the card portraits (those come from design/cards.json). kind picks the recipe in scripts/art_recipes.py (style references, prompt template, size, post-processing); where the files go comes from the kind (scripts/presmod.py KIND_OUTPUTS) unless the item lists its own "outputs" (paths relative to mod/, {id} = the character id). art = what to draw; {persona} = character.json art.persona. The prompts below are generic starting points made by scripts/new_character.py: give them the character's props and jokes before generating (docs/ART_PIPELINE.md). Add a relic, power or potion here when its class is added.

character.art: a character select portrait bust of {persona}, three-quarter view, a wide confident toothy grin, sunlight glinting off his aviators, on a solid flat saturated royal indigo blue background

character.name: Combat poses: Sleepy Joe
character.art: Exactly like the character in the reference image. He looks tired and sleepy in every pose: droopy eyebrows raised sleepily above his gold aviators, drowsy droopy cheeks. Pose 1: standing and yawning widely, one hand covering his open mouth. Pose 2: lunging to the right with a slow, lazy haymaker punch, mouth closed in a tired half-smile. Pose 3: leaning forward and pointing to the right mid-speech, a stack of index cards in his other hand, a sleepy lopsided smile. Pose 4: jolted awake, leaning backwards away from the right with both open hands raised in surprise, aviators knocked crooked, mouth in a small round o.

character.name: Combat poses: Dark Brandon
character.art: Exactly the same character, body proportions, head size and scale as the four figures in the first reference image, laid out the same way. Only his look changes: he is Dark Brandon, with the face and red lenses of the close-up in the second reference image: the lenses of his gold-rimmed aviators glow solid bright red with laser light, a stern confident smirk, dramatic red rim light along his silhouette. Pose 1: standing tall with his arms crossed. Pose 2: lunging to the right with a powerful punch. Pose 3: pointing forward to the right commandingly, jaw set. Pose 4: staggering back from a hit, one forearm raised to block, jaw set, lenses still glowing red. No laser beams.
